nodes.name: My journey began in Visual Arts, where I learned to see the world through different perspectives, explore creative possibilities, and understand the power of visual communication. With a multidisciplinary background spanning painting, photography, video, sculpture, and visual composition, I bring an artistic perspective to the world of digital design.

runs.text:
My journey began in Visual Arts, where I learned to see the world through different perspectives, explore creative possibilities, and understand the power of visual communication.

With a multidisciplinary background spanning painting, photography, video, sculpture, and visual composition, I bring an artistic perspective to the world of digital design.
